##### Project general facts

Address Villas Hillcrest is a first-of-its-kind residential project by Address Hotels & Resorts, nestled in the green heart of Dubai Hills Estate. Surrounded by tranquil lakes, streams, and lush greenery, this collection of luxury villas combines timeless architectural design with modern sophistication, set against breathtaking views of Burj Khalifa and the Dubai skyline.

The villas are crafted with meticulous attention to detail, blending contemporary elegance with functional living. Spacious layouts welcome abundant natural light, while refined finishes and thoughtful features such as provisions for private elevators enhance everyday comfort. Each residence embodies Address’ signature style, offering a seamless balance of luxury, serenity, and convenience.

Residents of Address Villas Hillcrest enjoy access to a wealth of exceptional amenities designed to enrich their lifestyle. From a community clubhouse with a gym and pool, to children’s play areas, recreational lawns, and lakeside picnic spots, the project fosters both relaxation and active living. With Dubai Hills Park, Dubai Hills Mall, and a championship golf course nearby, this is a destination that redefines refined family living.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Hills is a prestigious and vibrant master-planned community located in the heart of Dubai. Developed by Emaar Properties in collaboration with Meraas Holding, it represents a harmonious blend of luxury living, natural beauty, and modern urban design.

At the heart of Dubai Hills is the stunning 18-hole championship golf course, designed to international standards. The golf course adds a touch of greenery and serenity to the landscape, attracting golf enthusiasts from around the world.

Dubai Hills is not just a residential development - it's a comprehensive lifestyle destination. The Dubai Hills Mall, a world-class shopping and entertainment center, offers an array of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Residents and visitors can also enjoy the Central Park, a vast expanse of greenery and relaxation.
